description: Image Description: The image features a tall, ornate clock tower in the foreground. The tower has a classical design with a domed top and arched openings. A clock face is visible on the tower. In the background, there is a panoramic view of a cityscape with numerous rooftops. Beyond the city, a range of snow-capped mountains stretches across the horizon under a clear blue sky. The scene captures a blend of architectural detail and natural beauty.
